tagline: Bathroom Remodeling Contractors in Fort Mill, SC

why_choose_us.title: You deal with Vince, not a salesman
why_choose_us.description: Vincent Taylor owns TRC, prices the job himself, and is on site while it gets built. The person who quotes your bathroom is the person answerable for it.

why_choose_us.title: The waterproofing you never see
why_choose_us.description: Every custom shower gets a waterproof membrane, a properly sloped pan and full prep before a single tile goes up. That is the part that decides whether a shower lasts twenty years or two.

why_choose_us.title: Licensed in both Carolinas
why_choose_us.description: NC General Contractor #106823 and SC #60594, BBB Accredited with an A+ rating. One crew that can legally work either side of the state line.

why_choose_us.title: A two-day option when you want one
why_choose_us.description: Not every bathroom needs weeks of demo. Acrylic and composite wall systems go in over a couple of days with virtually no dust or mess.
